dict.string: The camera is used locally to verify that you are the owner. No images leave this Mac.
The microphone is used locally for voice commands and voice verification.
File search looks up file names on your Desktop when you ask for a file. Nothing leaves this Mac.
File search looks up file names in Documents when you ask for a file. Nothing leaves this Mac.
File search looks up file names in Downloads when you ask for a file. Nothing leaves this Mac.
Voice commands control other apps on this Mac, such as switching dark mode, typing dictated text and playing music.
